subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the final rebased set of 14 third-party action revisions be approved for the secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: Immutable SHAs prevent tag drift, but this grouped update changes executable supply-chain code across several privileged trust boundaries; repository history and CODEOWNERS assign that acceptance decision to human owners.

options.title: Audit and approve final head
options.body: Verify each SHA against its upstream release, rerun the affected workflow gates on the final rebased head, and approve the grouped update if all contracts remain compatible.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, Docker publishing, and CodeQL actions into smaller PRs when owners want independent audit and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Pause for a stable rebase
options.body: Leave the PR open without approval until Dependabot can produce a current, stable head with complete checks.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve final head
recommendation.body: Verify each SHA against its upstream release, rerun the affected workflow gates on the final rebased head, and approve the grouped update if all contracts remain compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest cross-cutting ownership of workflow modernization and agent/release hardening, while CODEOWNERS requires the relevant secops review.
